Only needed without a pairing code. The admin portal shows it under Settings › Advanced.
Enter the six digits from the admin portal's Devices page.
In the admin portal, open Devices and choose Show a pairing code, then enter it here. A phone with Sofa King installed can just scan the QR code.
That code didn't work. Codes last ten minutes and work once; show a new one in the admin portal.
This server is too old to pair with a code; enter its API token instead.
No Sofa King server answered at that address. Check the address and that this device is on the same network.
A channel that keeps focus opens full screen after this long. TalkBack touch exploration turns this off.
On streaming channels that mark their ads, such as Pluto TV and Tubi, a bouncing logo covers them. Select it to show the picture again.
Movie and show details and images can come from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Where I left off opens the channel you watched last, full screen, or the Library or DVR tab when you left the app there.
Select the channel the app opens on.
The Favorites filter in the guide and the channel list follow this order.
Star channels in the guide to put them in order here.
A group switched off hides all of its channels from the guide and the channel list on this device only; open a group to switch single channels. The server and other devices keep them.
Skip hidden channels with Channel Up and Down
How far Left and Right, Rewind and Fast Forward, the bar's step buttons and a double tap move a library item or a recording. A held key still moves a minute and then five.
Hides the summaries of unwatched episodes and blurs their pictures.
For movies and shows from the library. Live TV and recordings follow the caption style above.
A dark box behind the subtitles. Off, they are white with a shadow.
Automatically, Skip intro counts down 5 seconds and then skips; any key stops it. With a button, it waits for a press. Off, intros play.
Automatically, Skip credits counts down 5 seconds and then skips to the end, where Up next takes over; any key stops it. With a button, it waits for a press. Off, credits play.
Switches the display to the stream's frame rate while it plays. Some TVs show a black screen for a moment at each switch.
Software decoding helps the odd channel a hardware decoder can't play; it uses more power and may drop frames at high resolutions.
How much of a stream downloads before it plays: less starts sooner, more rides out network hiccups.
A PIN keeps Settings closed until it is entered. Watching and changing channels are not affected.
Settings now asks for the PIN. Forgot it? Choose Forgot the PIN on the lock screen and enter the server's API token.
Kids mode shows only kids' channels in the guide, and only titles rated G, PG, TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-Y7-FV, TV-G or TV-PG in the library. It hides the DVR tab. Turning it off takes the PIN.
Kids mode is on. Turn it off here to show every channel and title again.
Enter the PIN to open Settings.
Enter the server's API token instead. The admin portal shows it under Settings › Advanced: Reveal the API token. The right token removes the PIN.
This server runs without an API token, so the only way to remove the PIN is to clear the app's data on this device.
This server runs without an API token, so the only way to remove the PIN is to delete the app and install it again.
That's not the server's API token.
Send crash reports to your server

After a crash, the app sends what went wrong to your Sofa King server when it next starts: the error, the app version and this device's model. Never your server address, password, channels or titles, and never anywhere else. Off keeps nothing.

Keeps the favorites, their order and the hidden channels the same on every device of the household that has this on. Turning it on takes the household's list over when another device saved one.
